items.exampleEn: The average duration of a phone call is about two minutes.
items.exampleZh: 一通電話的平均時長大約是兩分鐘。

items.exampleEn: Your parking ticket expires in ten minutes.
items.exampleZh: 你的停車券再十分鐘就到期了。

items.exampleEn: Our new coach is much stricter than his predecessor.
items.exampleZh: 我們的新教練比他的前任嚴格得多。

items.exampleEn: A succession of visitors came to the door all morning.
items.exampleZh: 整個早上，訪客一個接一個上門。

items.exampleEn: The film has a continuity problem: his shirt changes color between scenes.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影有前後不連貫的問題：他的襯衫在兩個場景之間變了顏色。

items.exampleEn: At the outset of the course, every student takes a short test.
items.exampleZh: 課程一開始，每個學生都要做一個簡短的測驗。

items.exampleEn: The concert has been postponed indefinitely.
items.exampleZh: 那場演唱會已經無限期延後了。

items.sentenceEn: My passport will expire next month, so I need a new one.
items.sentenceZh: 我的護照下個月到期，所以我需要辦一本新的。

items.audioEn: The museum will be closed for the duration of the roof repairs.
items.audioZh: 屋頂整修期間，博物館將暫停開放。
items.questionZh: 博物館為什麼要暫停開放？
options: It is moving to a new place.

items.sentenceEn: She won three tennis matches in succession last weekend.
items.sentenceZh: 她上週末連續贏了三場網球比賽。

items.sentenceEn: From the outset, the project had a clear budget.
items.sentenceZh: 這個專案從一開始就有明確的預算。

items.stemEn: The new manager kept many ideas from her ____ because they worked well.
items.stemZh: 新經理保留了前任的許多點子，因為那些點子很有效。

items.stemEn: To ensure ____, the same teacher will stay with the class for three years.
items.stemZh: 為了確保連貫性，同一位老師會帶這個班三年。

items.passageEn: When Leo became manager of the city library, he made one thing clear from the outset: he would not change everything his predecessor had built. Mrs. Chen had run the library for twenty years, and readers loved her reading clubs. However, Leo did notice one problem. Many members forgot when their library cards would expire, so they could not borrow books. He set up a system that sends a message one month before that date. He also asked staff to stay in the same roles for the rest of the year, to give readers a sense of continuity. After three good months in succession, he decided to keep the new system indefinitely.
items.passageZh: Leo 當上市立圖書館館長時，一開始就說清楚一件事：他不會改掉前任建立的一切。陳女士經營這間圖書館二十年，讀者都很喜歡她辦的讀書會。不過，Leo 確實注意到一個問題。很多會員忘了自己的借書證何時到期，結果無法借書。他設立了一套系統，在到期日前一個月寄出通知。他也請館員在今年剩下的時間裡維持原本的職務，讓讀者有連貫感。連續三個月成效良好之後，他決定無限期沿用這套新系統。

questions.questionZh: Leo 上任時一開始就說清楚什麼？
options: 會把開放時間延長到晚上十點
不會改掉前任建立的一切
打算更換大部分的館員

questions.questionZh: 很多會員遇到什麼問題？
options: 找不到想借的那幾本書
忘了自己的借書證何時到期

items.promptZh: 這份合約在十二月底到期。
referenceEn: This contract expires at the end of December.
The contract will expire at the end of December.
rubricZh: expire 表示「到期」，時態配合內容（例如 expires、will expire 等）
「十二月底」可寫，例如 at the end of December 等

items.promptZh: 整趟航程中，那個嬰兒都在睡覺。
referenceEn: The baby slept for the whole duration of the flight.
The baby was asleep for the duration of the flight.
rubricZh: 「整趟⋯中」用 duration（例如 for the duration of、throughout the duration of 等）
「在睡覺」可寫，例如 slept、was asleep、was sleeping 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: disappearance 全部移除：q12 改用本課 succession、outset；q13 改用 duration、distance（皆為名詞、放得進空格但語意不通）與 indefinitely

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似不自然：stay in the same roles for the duration of the year 略生硬，for the rest of the year／throughout the year 較道地；duration 宜接事件（for the duration of the renovation 等）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "stay in the same roles for the rest of the year"，中譯同步「在今年剩下的時間裡」；duration 仍見於造句題

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（同課 mcq 不可拿另一題正解當干擾項）：q12 用了 q13 正解 continuity
執行長最終複審修正：干擾項 silence 為 A2 低階字、與題意無關，一眼可排除
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: silence 換成 deadline（B1，與單元時間主題相關；kept many ideas from her deadline 語意不通）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改寫為「Our new coach is much stricter than his predecessor.」示範第一義；釋義為「前任；（產品的）前一代」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（執行長釋義原則）：expire 例句「This milk expired yesterday, so please don't drink it.」示範的是次要義，第一義應為最常用義「到期」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改寫為「Your parking ticket expires in ten minutes.」示範第一義；釋義為「到期；過期、失效」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：duration 的用法，例如 for the duration of the movie 等，表示「在⋯的整段期間」／時態配合內容即可（例如 turn off、stayed 等）
